_comment: Techno-organic waste: the compacted depths' bulk block.
THE DUMP GIVES SCRAP; MACHINES GIVE MATERIALS (owner, 2026-08-19). Copper is not in a
household mound - scrap metal is, and the Cupola smelts it. Quartz is not in here for exactly
the same reason. An earlier version of this table handed over glowstone dust, quartz, blaze
powder, magma cream, ghast tears and nether wart directly, which broke the rule the whole
economy rests on and skipped every machine the player owns.
Three things are direct, and all three because they are ALREADY unprocessed:
slag            - the non-metallic fraction of a remelt. Cooked waste IS slag.
netherite scrap - vanilla's own word for an intermediate; four of them plus gold plus a
smithing template is still ahead of you, so it is a scrap, not a metal.
lignite         - brown coal. A real rank of coal, the one below the coal vanilla ships,
so this is the thing BEFORE the machine rather than past it (#226).
The three scrap categories are e-waste at civilisational scale rather than science fiction,
which is what makes 'techno-organic' mean something: server racks, lamps and screens, and the
biological matter cooked in with them. Each feeds one machine verb and each has a real-world
referent, because material literacy is flavour AND tutorial here.
What is NOT here and will not be: blaze rods, magma cream and ghast tears. There is no honest
industrial residue that grinds into a ghast tear - they are mob drops, and the fortresses,
bastions and ghasts already supply them.
Weights first-pass; #36 owns them.

OILY SWARF answers to two verbs, which is why it is one item and not two. The mill reduces it to burning metal fines (blaze powder); the separator divides it into its oil and its chips (magma cream, byproduct scrap metal). Slag already works this way - three verbs, three outputs - so the precedent is in the mod rather than invented for this.
NO MAGMA SHARD (owner, 2026-08-19). There was one, briefly, and it earned nothing: vanilla already
crafts a magma block from four magma cream, and Oily Swarf gives magma cream a route - so the block
arrived the moment the cream did. The shard was a second parallel path to something already
reachable, which is the one thing a terrain shard must not be. The other five are each the ONLY
route to their block, because the depths generate no vanilla nether terrain at all.

LIGNITE is the third direct entry, and it qualifies for the same reason the other two do: it is already unprocessed. Lignite IS brown coal - the real rank between peat and the bituminous coal vanilla calls 'coal' - so finding it here is not skipping a machine, it is finding the thing before the machine. Smelting upgrades it (#226), which is the only route to coal in this world.

A WORN FORGING DIE is the one OBJECT in this table rather than a material, and it is here because the knowledge it carries has nowhere else to come from (#249). Everything else in the depths is scrap you process; a die is a thing you tear down at the Workbench to learn the pattern stamped into it. It is the seam's only route to netherite GEAR, which vanilla otherwise locks behind a bastion chest and a recipe that needs its own output.
